operations.text: Doctrine: a ticket born after a standing operator word is written into the PLAN, announced in ONE sentence and STOPS - zero mutations on it until an explicit word for THAT ticket (the earlier 'announcement, not a question' reading is revoked). Review: the brief now carries `Class: docs | code`, a docs-class ticket is reviewed on the Claude host whatever roles.reviewer.engine says, and a cheap fact-check pass over the prose of the diff runs before any paid pass; a second paid pass is for correction rounds that touched code. Permissions: the blanket `Bash(git -C:*)` ask rule is gone from the factory ruleset - it gated read-only -C forms against any repository while adding nothing to the push/merge/rebase gate, which keeps its three rendered `git -C <projectRoot> ...` forms. This migration removes that rule only where this plugin inserted it; a rule you added or edited yourself is untouched.
